I believe it is only fair that these issues be rectified promptly.

The receipt you signed when collecting the suit states plainly that no alterations or refunds are given once the garment leaves the shop. Mr. Mueller is very particular about that policy - it protects us from customers who may damage items themselves and then seek recompense.

*shifts weight uncomfortably*
